knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Sender identification and a working unsubscribe are required for commercial electronic messages. A discount code or photo is not a legal requirement.
The ACMA guidance in this lesson sets five business days for acting on opt-out requests.
Buying a list does not remove the duty to confirm consent for each address.
The plan the cadence section gives a note of thanks after a milestone, a birthday card, or a check-in after a long absence as examples of personal touches.

practicalCriteria: Given a sample contact list with consent sources, the learner sorts each contact into eligible or not eligible for electronic messages with a reason
The learner completes a newsletter template with sender identity and a working unsubscribe, and the assessor checks both elements
The learner records an opt-out and the date it was actioned, within five business days
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop sending any electronic message to a contact with no consent record
Stop any message missing the sender identity or unsubscribe option
